auxiliary_metric: 0.7*spell_f1 + 0.3*macro_f1, descriptive only and never a ranking metric

candidate_methods.equal_50_50_new_full_plus_archived_calib: For each seed and phase, average new full-model and archived calibrated-model probabilities 50/50; then ensemble seeds, equal-mean phases and decode with frozen f062.
candidate_methods.new_conditional_HA_x_archived_calibrated: For each seed and phase, retain the new model's conditional H/A ratio and replace its D probability with that seed/fold's archived calibrated-D probability; then ensemble seeds, equal-mean phases and decode with frozen f062.
candidate_methods.new_full_phase_tta: For each held-out-provider fold, ensemble the two new full H/A/D fits within each fixed native sampling phase; equal-mean phases (five at 25 Hz, two at 10 Hz); decode once with frozen f062.

cohort.aggregation: four v2 realizations within match; matches equally within provider; three provider means equally
cohort.heldout_rule: each candidate fit and both archived controls omit the evaluated provider from all learned components and normalization
cohort.v2_seed_rule: feed_like_v2_benchmark/{rep}/{match} SHA-256-derived seed, exactly as upstream prepared-cell runtime

controls.calibrated_phase_tta: Reused upstream v2_spell_target_runtime controls-only C0 for adop/calibrated D2: equal mean across native phases then f062.
controls.original_full_phase_tta: Reused upstream v2_spell_target_runtime controls-only C0 for cand/original_full: equal mean across native phases then f062.

guardrails.baseline: reused calibrated_phase_tta C0 (adop) from the upstream controls-only preflight
guardrails.clean_equal_provider: for spell_f1, macro_f1 and d_f1, each candidate arm must be at least baseline - 0.005
guardrails.clean_provider: for each provider, macro_f1 and d_f1 must be at least baseline - 0.02
guardrails.feed_like_v2_equal_provider: spell_f1 must be at least baseline - 0.01
guardrails.interpretation: report each guard; no promotion or adoption decision

limitations: Five exposed development matches and synthetic feed_like_v2 views; this cannot establish independent continuous-match generalization.

component_seed_diagnostics.aggregation: save each seed's score in every cell; average realizations within match, matches within provider, then providers equally; report provider values separately
component_seed_diagnostics.selection_use: descriptive only; no seed selection or reselection

metrics.primary: official possession spell F1; macro F1 breaks exact ties
metrics.provider_reporting: retain provider-level clean and feed_like_v2 spell/macro/D metrics; no adoption decision in runner

question: Do four-view v2-trained full H/A/D fits reach or exceed 0.60 equal-provider official spell F1 on fixed feed_like_v2 development views, and how do conditional-HA transfer and a calibrated-model blend compare?
